# Dean Studio

> AI-native designer who also ships the frontend, with no handoff between design and build. UI/UX and creative design that make Web3 products easy to understand.

Dean Studio is the portfolio of Dean, an AI-native UI/UX designer and frontend developer. The site is an interactive 3D hardware-wallet-style device: its screen holds the works, events, about and contact; a plain List view shows the same content as a normal page. Site: https://www.dean-fi.my/

## Selected works
- [Kairma](https://www.kairma.ai/): AI Workforce Platform. Next.js, React, Turbopack, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Lenis. Flagship project.
- [Stashcube](https://stashcube.vercel.app/): Curated Library. Next.js, React, Turbopack, Tailwind CSS. Flagship project.
- [FlowFi](https://www.flowfidao.com/): Treasury Protocol. Vite, Vanilla JS, GSAP. Flagship project.
- [NARO](https://naro-mu.vercel.app/): On-chain Asset Launchpad. React, Vite, Three.js, ethers.js. Flagship project. Mobile app, a redesign of https://naroradar.com/; runs on BSC Testnet.
- [ASEAN Labs](https://aseanlabs.io/): Web3 Execution Layer. Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, WebGL. Flagship project.

## More projects
- [ENI Network](https://eni.top/): Modular L1 Blockchain. Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, TanStack Query, viem.
- [OpenCrew](https://open-crew.vercel.app/): Global Web3 & AI Team. Next.js, React, Turbopack, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lenis, WebGL.
- [PayGo](https://www.paygo.ac/): Machine-Native Payments. React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, React Three Fiber, GSAP, Framer Motion.
- [PUSC](https://pusc-liard.vercel.app/): Algorithmic Stablecoin. React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
- [Fortuna HK](https://www.fortunahkholding.com/): Professional Services. Next.js, React, Turbopack, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lenis.
- [Nikola](https://www.nikola.network/): AI Coordination Layer. React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, React Three Fiber, GSAP, Framer Motion.

## Events
- Selangor AI & Semiconductor Summit 2026 (Kuala Lumpur, Speaker): I spoke on the Fire Stage at the Selangor AI & Semiconductor Summit 2026.
- ENI DeFi Week World Tour (Changsha, Speaker): I spoke at ENI DeFi Week in Changsha, representing ASEAN Labs as the official project incubator for ENI.
- Web3 + RWA Global Infrastructure Summit (Hangzhou, Speaker): I represented ASEAN Labs at the Web3 + RWA Global Infrastructure Summit in Hangzhou, organised by ENI.
- Monster GameFi Soft Launch (Bali, Host & Keynote): I hosted the Monster GameFi soft launch in Bali during Coinfest week, a community event run by ASEAN Labs in joint venture with HODL, Kripto101, Pionex and 9Bit.
- Chain of Trust (Kuala Lumpur, Presenter): I presented ASEAN Labs at Chain of Trust, an event hosted by CCACC and Fableration for Malaysia’s Web3 and tech communities.
- Christmas Crypto Gala (Kuala Lumpur, Panelist): I joined the panel at the Christmas Crypto Gala, co-hosted by ASEAN Labs and MySekolahKripto, on the future of Web3 in Malaysia.
- PayGo × ENI Community Night (Kuala Lumpur, Presenter): I presented ASEAN Labs at PayGo × ENI Community Night, hosted by PayGo and ASEAN Labs in joint venture with Finweek KL.
- NOVA × MEXC Builders Session (Selangor, Speaker): I was invited, in a personal capacity, to share my experience in Web3 at a session hosted by MySekolahKripto in joint venture with MEXC.
- Blockchain Evolution 2025 (Selangor, Speaker): I represented GameSpace at Blockchain Evolution 2025, hosted by MySekolahKripto in joint venture with two GameFi projects, EUFT and GameSpace.
